I am not a licensed medical professional, and I cannot diagnose medical conditions or assess whether you have cancer. Only a qualified healthcare provider who can review your full medical history, conduct a physical exam, and order appropriate diagnostic tests can give you an accurate answer.

It is common for many mild or temporary symptoms to cause worry about serious illnesses like cancer, but most of these symptoms are caused by far less serious, common health issues. If you are experiencing persistent, unexplained changes in your health (such as unexplained weight loss, ongoing fatigue, new lumps or swelling, changes in bowel or bladder habits, persistent pain, unusual bleeding, or other symptoms that do not resolve on their own), it is important to schedule an appointment with your doctor as soon as possible to get evaluated. Early detection of any health concern, including cancer, greatly improves treatment outcomes, so please do not delay reaching out to a healthcare provider if you have worries about your health.
